job.question: What contract term, including any extension options, does the Los Angeles Fire and Police Pensions (LAFPP) RFP for financial statement audit services contemplate?
job.expected_facts: A three-year contract (fiscal years ending June 30, 2025, 2026 and 2027) with a maximum fee proposal for each fiscal year; the Board may extend beyond the three-year term through two one-year renewals.
job.acceptance: Three years plus two optional one-year renewals, up to five years, suffices. Fiscal-year dates and fee-proposal details are optional.

reviews.reason: This is an OCERS RFP for investment consultant services, not the LAFPP RFP for financial statement audit services. Its five-year initial term and possible one-year renewal do not support the requested contract term.
quotes: Investment Consultant Services for: General Investments and Risk Private Equity Real Assets Real Estate
The initial term of the contract awarded pursuant to this RFP will be for a five (5) year period, with OCERS retaining the option to renew the contract for up to an additional one (1) year.
